definitions.explanation: The evening or night immediately preceding a particular event or day. Often used for the eve of holidays, ceremonies, or significant occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧{前夜|ぜんや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We ate cake on Christmas Eve.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前夜|ぜんや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}して→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: I was so nervous the night before the exam that I couldn't sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前夜|ぜんや}、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The night before the wedding, the whole family had dinner together.

notes:
{前夜|ぜんや} refers to the night immediately before an event. Also used figuratively for the period just before a major change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前夜|ぜんや}{祭|さい}: eve festival, preliminary celebration
- ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧{前夜|ぜんや}: Christmas Eve
- ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前夜|ぜんや}: the night before a tournament
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前夜|ぜんや}: the night before an exam

USAGE:
{前夜|ぜんや} can describe the period just before a historical turning point:
- ⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前夜|ぜんや}: the eve of revolution
- ⟦{開戦|かいせん}→開戦：14816_kaisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前夜|ぜんや}: the eve of war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧: the day before (daytime, more neutral)
- ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{晩|ばん}→晩：00542_ban⟧: the night before (casual)
- イブ: eve (loanword, mainly for Christmas)
